# Bundle size

What each component adds to an app that installs `@efolusi/meridian` from npm.

Every row is one deep import, such as `@efolusi/meridian/forms/Button.js`, bundled on its own and minified. It includes the Meridian modules that component imports and leaves out React, react-dom and recharts, which the app already loads. Components that import the same module (Icon, Button, Portal) share those bytes, so the rows do not add up to the total.

Any component that renders an icon carries the full icon set, about 6.9 kB gzipped, because the icon name is a runtime string a bundler cannot tree-shake.

CSS is not counted per component: `styles.css` ships every component style in one file.

## Totals

| File | Size | Gzip |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `@efolusi/meridian` | 346.2 kB | 77.6 kB |
| `dist/components.css` | 193.9 kB | 27.5 kB |
| `_ds_bundle.js` | 783.8 kB | 138.6 kB |

The root import, `@efolusi/meridian`, is every component. `_ds_bundle.js` is the zero-build CDN bundle, which also carries each component's CSS. The root import is minified; the CSS and the CDN bundle are measured as shipped.
